parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center instance from which you want to remove users.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description:
The ID of the user to remove from the Cloud Call Center instance.


**UserId.1** removes a single agent. To remove multiple agents, specify multiple parameters such as UserId.1, UserId.2, and UserId.3. For more information, see the request examples below.
